arStrings.szText: Encounter new challenges in {icon:Marker_ApparitionIncursionSigil, 2.3} {c_highlight}Apparition Incursions{/c} to battle against {icon:Marker_ApparitionIncursionBelial, 2.3}{c_highlight} Belial, Lord of Lies{/c}!
Earn {c_highlight}Unveiler's Oath{/c} reputation by defeating {c_highlight}Apparitions{/c} and {c_highlight}Bosses{/c} across Sanctuary. Gain more reputation at higher {c_highlight}Torment Tiers{/c}.
